name: Bayreuth (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided black over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bayreuth (quartered with Zollern chequy and lions, and a black-and-white bend).
history: Municipal flag of Bayreuth; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bayreuth arms — quartered with lions and chequy
